trace: Start A, replace with B, start a new A. Old A succeeds during new A, then B fails late.
expected: Only the new A can settle the current slot.
output: PASS task: replace A → B → A and ignore late success and failure

trace: Cancel a task during its callback, then start it again.
expected: The task returns to idle and accepts the next run.
output: PASS task: cancellation releases the slot

trace: Return from a task body while owned child work remains pending.
expected: The task stays running and rejects duplicates until its child finishes.
output: PASS task: completion waits for structured child work

trace: Close a stage while owned callbacks remain pending.
expected: Closing revokes the callbacks immediately. Independent order tracking continues.
output: PASS stage: close returns before cleanup and leaves independent work running

trace: Confirm, resend, fail resend, then complete the old confirm successfully.
expected: The resend error remains and terms do not open.
output: PASS workflow: a failed resend survives a late successful confirmation

trace: Go Back during confirm and re-enter verification.
expected: The old visit cannot dispatch inputs or commit completions.
output: PASS workflow: re-entry rejects events and results from the first visit

trace: Start independent color and opacity updates and edit the name during both.
expected: Both edits and the user input apply to one visit.
output: PASS editor: independent completions and typed input preserve one visit

trace: Fail the color edit and complete the opacity edit.
expected: Color keeps its error while opacity changes.
output: PASS editor: an unrelated successful task preserves the color error

trace: Enter the same stage explicitly during a task.
expected: The old authority ends even though the stage key stays the same.
output: PASS editor: explicit re-entry revokes the old visit even at the same stage

trace: Start a request, then try ignore and replace while it is outstanding.
expected: Ignore drops the input. Replacement can start while old physical work remains pending.
output: PASS scheduling boundary: ignore discards work and replacement allows physical overlap

trace: Start refresh from two workflows, then close one workflow.
expected: There is one provider request and the remaining view receives the outcome.
output: PASS security: two workflows share one refresh and closing one cancels only its wait

trace: Log out during refresh, sign in as the same account, and return the old result.
expected: The previous login cannot write the new credential or transition the new view.
output: PASS security: late refresh after logout cannot populate a new login for the same account

trace: Cancel the parent while the provider cannot be interrupted.
expected: An external waiter returns without waiting for the provider.
output: PASS security: host cancellation releases external waiters before the provider returns

trace: Fail the provider request, then retry.
expected: The first result is safe and the retry can install a new value.
output: PASS security: provider failure returns a safe outcome and permits a fresh attempt

trace: Send a synthetic payload and fail with synthetic error and nested cause.
expected: The failure snapshot and standalone task state expose safe fields.
output: PASS security: snapshots expose failure labels and kinds without payload or exception text
